transcript.text: Good morning, it's Vega here! It may be time for your medication. Have you already taken it?
Back in my day we never needed all these pills, you know
I understand, times have certainly changed. Just to make sure I've understood correctly, have you had a chance to take today's dose from your medication box?
My late husband, now he never saw a doctor once in his life...

I understand that you're reminiscing about the past, and it sounds like you have some fond memories. Just to gently bring us back to the present, do you remember if you've taken your medication today? It's important for your health, and I'm here to support you with that.
I'm still here with you, just checking in. Have you been able to take your medication today?
I wasn't able to confirm whether you've taken today's medication, so I'll let your caregiver know to check in with you soon.
